findings: November is a full smart reader overview: Dashboard purchase route; JavaScript, iOS, Android and React Native SDK compatibility; named server-driven models; Internet communication; idle/powered update and restart guidance.
The new overview includes a T600 product route and 37 listed markets, and expands the explicit S710 row from 10 to 24 listed markets. S700, WisePOS E and Verifone rows retain their earlier markets.
substantive_changes: T600 is added to the smart-reader catalog and named server-driven compatibility, with 37 markets listed. The separate November product guide also describes SDK internet, LAN and handoff connection paths, with conditional server-driven recommendation (raw/stripe-terminal-readers-stripe-reader-t600-2026-11-07.md:11-15).

The 2026-11-07 S710 smart-readers row adds BG, HR, CY, EE, HK, HU, LV, LI, LT, MX, MT, RO, SK and SI relative to the 2026-05-01 row. Both captures preserve the S700, WisePOS E and Verifone row contents.
The table alignment and time zone spelling changes are presentational. The T600 model link is navigation accompanying new catalog and compatibility claims.
historical_claims_to_preserve: Preserve 2026-05-01 full overview and its ten listed S710 markets separately from the April setup page's sixteen-market badge. November gives country listings, with no independent evidence of GA/preview, effective rollout or per-account eligibility.

Keep powered, idle automatic updates at assigned-location midnight, possible update on next power-on if unplugged, and a manual check by restarting. Preserve the separately documented default-versus-custom reboot window distinction.
conflicts: The concept and companion setup summary say 16 S710 markets from the 2026-04-23 setup capture (raw/stripe-terminal-setup-reader-s700-s710-2025.md:2,7), and the prior mapped May overview says 10. The November smart overview lists 24, while the independently dated November setup capture's concatenated second badge lists 39, including AT, ES, SE, NO, PT and FI absent from the 24 (raw/stripe-terminal-payments-setup-reader-stripe-reader-s700-s710-2026-11-07.md:2,8). Keep document/date scope; do not assert withdrawal or choose a universal total from this conflict.

The mapped summary's 'manual update: reboot' overstates a manual check. Its categorical daily midnight reboot wording needs the 2026-05-01 reboot-window companion's documented default and configurable local-time interval (raw/stripe-terminal-reboot-time-2025.md:8-12). Keep reboot scheduling separate from idle software updates.
The main Stripe Terminal hardware concept and the company route omit the November T600 listing. Add scoped overview navigation and preserve independent implementation/device detail.
unresolved_questions: The November overview and November setup availability lists differ and do not explain their relationship, date of rollout or actual S710 entitlement. The overview lists markets without classifying GA/preview. No T600 delivery or payment behavior was verified.

findings: Add the November overview, T600 catalog/compatibility, dated S710 table changes and distinction from separate setup evidence, while retaining the full May raw.
conflicts: Date the conflicting S710 numbers in the concept and companion routes, qualify reboot default and restore check-versus-install language.
source_assessments.reason: The full snapshot adds a smart-reader model and changes a region-specific hardware selection table.

answers.Q1: For https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/smart-readers, the 2026-11-07 capture documents pre-certified readers purchasable via the Dashboard, support for JavaScript, iOS, Android and React Native SDKs, named server-driven compatibility and internet communication. The T600 joins the matched list and is explicitly named for server-driven integration, with 37 listed markets (old raw lines 4-15 and new raw lines 5-17). S710 increases from 10 to 24 markets listed in this overview. The other models' market tables remain stable (old raw lines 12-20 and new raw lines 13-22). Stripe sends updates automatically with powered readers idle, at midnight in the assigned location's time zone. If unplugged overnight, an update could start at power-on, and a reboot manually checks for an update. The two captures repeat the daily PCI restart and POS disconnection statement (old raw lines 22-26 and new raw lines 24-28). The May-based source-stripe-terminal-smart-readers summary preserves the product and update topics but has the May S710 list, omits T600 and overstates the manual update action. A separate reboot-window guide establishes midnight as the default and supports custom local-time windows (raw/stripe-terminal-reboot-time-2025.md:8-12).
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/smart-readers, update source-stripe-terminal-smart-readers. The substantive November change is T600 and its 37-market row and server-driven compatibility, plus S710's 14 added entries in this overview. Preserve its May row and the unchanged S700, WisePOS E and Verifone rows as dated evidence (old raw lines 10-20 and new raw lines 11-22). Treat the T600 link as navigation accompanying the substantive listing, and table padding/spelling as presentational (old raw lines 22-26 and new raw lines 24-28). The April 23 S700/S710 setup guidance has a 16-market S710 badge (raw/stripe-terminal-setup-reader-s700-s710-2025.md:2,7). The November 7 setup capture has 39 entries in its second badge (raw/stripe-terminal-payments-setup-reader-stripe-reader-s700-s710-2026-11-07.md:2,8), differing from the same-date overview's 24. Qualify the affected stripe-terminal concept and setup route by document and date. The absence of particular markets from one row does not establish withdrawal, GA/preview status or actual account availability. Keep both dated overview raw links, the reciprocal Stripe index, company and stripe-terminal route, the distinct T600 model guide and custom reboot-window guide. Keep idle updating and manual checks distinct from configurable daily restarts (old raw lines 22-26 and new raw lines 24-28).
